Here’s a conversational look at five of the biggest technology stories from the week.

Apple Inc. reported fiscal fourth-quarter revenue of $114.48 billion, topping analyst estimates of $113.39 billion. The iPhone maker also posted earnings of $2.10 per share, above the expected $1.98, while its active installed base reached an all-time high.

Palantir Technologies Inc. reported third-quarter revenue of $2.31 billion, exceeding estimates of $2.18 billion. The AI software company’s adjusted earnings came in at 44 cents per share, ahead of the 41-cent consensus estimate, and the company raised its guidance.
